name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: An app that clones your voice and lets you generate speech, dub videos into other languages, and turn text into audiobooks, all running on your own computer with no subscription.
buyer: An indie audiobook narrator, course creator, or small dubbing studio that wants ElevenLabs-quality voice cloning without ongoing per-minute API fees or sending voice data to the cloud.
business_use_cases: A course creator narrates once, then uses voice cloning to auto-generate dubbed versions of their course in ten languages without hiring voice actors.
A news/explainer YouTuber dictates a script and gets narration back instantly instead of recording and re-recording takes.
A small dubbing studio undercuts competitors by dubbing indie films and YouTube content locally, avoiding per-minute cloud TTS costs on high-volume work.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'we dub your course or video into five languages' productized service using cloned voices
Build a simple upload-and-dub SaaS wrapper charging per minute processed, undercutting ElevenLabs by running the open engine on your own GPUs

steal_this: This weekend, clone your own voice, batch-dub five of your old YouTube or blog videos into Spanish and Portuguese, and post them as a demo of a paid course-localization service.
